scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@acres/shared && npm run build --workspace=@acres/client && npm run build --workspace=@acres/server
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=@acres/client && npm run lint --workspace=@acres/shared && npm run lint --workspace=@acres/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=@acres/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@acres/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@acres/client && npm run typecheck --workspace=@acres/server
scripts.deps:up: docker compose up -d postgres valkey garage clamav
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d postgres
